transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm visiting today because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past six months. It feels like this heavy, gloomy cloud just won't leave me, and I don't know what to do anymore. I really need some help getting through this.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I can't really think of any specific stressful event or major life change that triggered this. These feelings just seemed to start on their own, and it felt like I woke up one day with this heavy cloud over me.
Before these past six months, have you felt depressed or down most days for at least two years, or is this more of a newer episode?
No, I definitely haven't felt like this for two years. This is a much newer episode that just started about six months ago. Before this, I didn't feel depressed or down most of the time at all.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say I've lost interest in the things I enjoy, and I'm not really sure about that. It's more that I just feel completely empty and numb even when I try to do them. The heavy sadness is just always there in the background.
Over the past six months, have you been worrying excessively about a lot of different things on most days, and found it hard to control the worry?
No, I haven't really experienced excessive or uncontrollable worry about a lot of different things over the past six months. My mind doesn't really race with those kinds of worries.
During this period, have you had changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

Yes, I've had huge changes in my sleep and energy where I barely sleep for nights but feel completely refreshed and full of overflowing energy. As for my appetite, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness and guilt, I haven't really noticed any changes in those areas.
During those times when you barely slept and felt full of energy, did you hear or see things others couldn’t, or strongly believe things that others said weren’t true?

Yes, during those two months when I had all that energy and barely slept, I actually did hear voices and see things that others couldn't, and I believed I had special powers and that people were plotting against me. But those experiences only happened during those high-energy times and completely went away afterward.
Have you ever had those voices, visions, or unusual beliefs when you were not in one of those high-energy, little-sleep periods?

No, I've never had those voices or beliefs when my energy was normal or when I've been feeling down. They only happen during those times when I'm full of energy and barely sleeping. Once that high-energy phase ends, those experiences completely disappear.
